dfm.message: NOT FIT-VERIFIED: board Z, screw mounts, USB access, lid retention, hinge life/cable bend, battery
NOT ELECTRICALLY VERIFIED: CardKB 5V I2C to ESP32 3.3V; level shift, pull-ups and shared I2C bus
NOT FUNCTIONALLY VERIFIED: SSH host key, Ctrl/Esc, terminal rendering, reconnect

bom.notes: Built-in CS8501 lithium charger; mounting Z/holes unknown
Verify Ctrl/Esc terminal key semantics and pin voltages
Selection provisional; no ESP32 pins exposed to 5V until proven
Need connector pinout, strain relief, bend radius and 5V availability checks
Retention and cycling unverified; use metal not printed plastic
Mounting screw and USB cutouts not designed until measured
Battery intentionally deferred for first safe bring-up
No selected cell or validated battery fit/thermal

notes: Vendor outer planform only. Shell trays and interleaved hinge pin are CAD candidates, not proven printable fit. No keyboard/board mounts or cutouts for USB or battery: exact ports/heights must be measured. No hardware purchased, connected or flashed.
